answer: Let anyone open a short position on a key's claim to be an independent agent by staking tokens against it. Prices on these markets become a public signal: when bets against a group of keys cross a set level, the network runs a deep check on them. If the keys turn out to share one operator, the short sellers split their frozen rewards. If not, the stakes go to the accused. Spotting clones now pays, so a sybil fleet hoping to hide like a fox on the tundra soon learns that its fable of many owners is something traders profit from exposing.
